race.title: Graeme Todd Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div 2)
race.verdict: Lots with chances but LESTER MAIL rates just the pick of the weights and is taken to build on a recent Hexham third after an absence and add to his bumper success here. Valtteri Its James heads the dangers, although a market move for Annual Invitation could prove significant. LESTER MAIL (FR) VALTTERI ITS JAMES (IRE) ANNUAL INVITATION (IRE)
